caption:
$403 per kW per month: wholesale colo in Singapore, the top of the global ladder on the Coloprice Index.

São Paulo sits at $160, so a kW costs 2.5x more in Singapore. Hong Kong reads $295 and Tokyo $280, flat on the year at +0% YoY. Singapore rose from $340 in Jun 2024 to $403 in Dec 2025 and has not moved since. Note that London and Amsterdam are Q1 2026, 250–500 kW asking rates.

Data: Coloprice Colocation Index, Oct 2026 (CBRE underlying). Sources on the last slide.
